# SEO-162: Keep structured data consistent with the content visible on the page

This page is generated from the canonical JSONL registry record. Edit the JSONL record and run `npm run docs -- --write`; do not edit this file directly.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Domain | `structured-data` |

| Minimum level | `LITE` |
| Severity | `CRITICAL` |

| Evidence tier | `A` |
| Confidence | `HIGH` |

## Statement

Every value asserted in the markup - name, price, availability, date, author, rating, breadcrumb trail - is also present in the visible content of the same page and says the same thing.

## Rationale

Markup describing something the page does not show is treated as misleading under published guidelines, and the mismatch is what triggers manual action rather than the markup simply being ignored.

## Applicability

```json
{
  "all": [
    "public_site"
  ],
  "any": [
    "has_structured_data"
  ]
}
```

## Implementation

Generate the markup from the same data the template renders, in the same request, so the two cannot diverge. Never populate a property from a default, a placeholder, or a value fetched separately from the one displayed.

## Verification

- Level: `SOURCE_AND_RUNTIME`
- Method: For each asserted property, search the visible text of the same response for the value and report properties whose value does not appear.
- Evidence: `JSON_LD`, `RENDERED_HTML`, `ROUTE`
- Automated check: none.

## Scope

- Search surfaces: `GOOGLE_SEARCH`, `BING_SEARCH`
- Frameworks: `any`
- Caution: none recorded.
